# CTO advisor (Alireza Rezvani)

Frameworks for tech debt, architecture direction, team scaling and technology bets.

- Source: https://github.com/alirezarezvani/claude-skills
- SKILL.md: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alirezarezvani/claude-skills/main/c-level-advisor/skills/cto-advisor/SKILL.md
- Author: Alireza Rezvani
- License: MIT
- Page: https://commandvault.ai/commands/cto-advisor-alireza-rezvani-4285f8ff

Gives Claude a CTO's playbook for questions such as whether to rewrite, how to grow an engineering team, or which technology to adopt. It covers technology strategy, build-vs-buy, managing technical debt, team structure and DORA metrics. Reference files hold an evaluation framework and engineering metrics, and two Python scripts analyze tech debt and model team scaling.

**Try asking:**
- "Should we rewrite our Rails monolith or keep refactoring it? Here is the context"
- "We are 12 engineers and growing to 30 next year. How should the team be structured?"
- "Help me evaluate buying an auth provider versus building our own"
